description:
One `LeafBinding` entry in JSON: exactly one of `leaf` (key type 1) or `key_package_ref`
(key type 2), the join id and its engine identity (S50 §9.5).

leaf.description: The leaf index (commit, welcome, K3 reply, recorder tables).

lk_identity.description: `p_` + base32 of `join_id` (not signed; clients recompute and compare).

title: LeafBindingEntryJson
